title: Ruth — Instructions and Commands
content:
Ruth — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

19 additional passage records · 23 quoted verse units. Read Ruth in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Faith, repentance and allegiance · Worship, prayer and holy things · Mercy, neighbors and the vulnerable · Family, marriage and household · Work, possessions and stewardship · Historical commissions, journeys and public life

Faith, repentance and allegiance

Historical · 2 passage records

Ruth 1:16

Record type: Historical direction. Source section: Ruth Will Not Leave Her.

Ruth 1:16 — But Ruth said, “Do not oppose me by making me leave you or turn back from following you, for wherever you go, I will go, and wherever you lodge, I will lodge. Your people are my people, and your God my God.

Context and scope: A direction recorded in this narrative. Its original speaker, recipient and occasion must be retained; recording an order does not establish that God approves it or commands every believer to repeat it.

Ruth 3:13

Record type: Historical direction. Source section: Boaz Promises to Act as Kinsman.

Ruth 3:13 — Lodge tonight. In the morning, if he will act as your next of kin, good; let him do so. But if he is unwilling to act as your next of kin, I will act as your next of kin, as the Lord lives. Lie down until morning.”
